findings.suggested_fix: Rewrite Client/ScoreReq/CompleteReq/SummarizeReq/ClassifyReq/Meta to match contract T001-topic-model.md §一 and seam-manifest.yaml SEAM-LLM-CLIENT/SEAM-LLM-REQTYPES exactly: no Meta in method return values, Meta{Origin store.Origin} embedded in each Req, ClassifyReq{Meta; Snap store.CardSnapshot}. Define store.CardSnapshot{CardID, GroupName, Summary string, Texts []string, Origin store.Origin} in internal/store as required.

Change Transition to func Transition(ctx context.Context, st *store.Store, cardID string, to store.CardState, reason string) error: look up current state, validate via the existing legality table, then perform a single-document CAS update of state+updated_at, returning store.ErrIllegalTransition (not a topic-local sentinel) and writing nothing on failure. This is the only way T003/T004/T006 can avoid independently reimplementing racy UpdateOne(state) calls.

Change CardStateCollecting's literal from "collecting" to "aggregating" and CardStatePendingReview's literal from "pending_review" to "pending" to match the pinned wire encoding (aggregating/todo/pending/chitchat_archived/following/done/merged) that other features are meant to consume verbatim.

Add IsOurs(ctx, wxid) (bool, error) and ListMembers(ctx) ([]store.OurMember, error) to Registry, and declare a Registry interface (with NewRegistry returning it) so T003 can implement isOurs = msg.is_our_side || Registry.IsOurs(sender_wxid) per spec §一 and FR-014/015/016.

Deliver the remaining T001 scope: ScratchState (NewScratch/Cards/Links/Snapshot), topic.Deps struct with all interface slots + nil-safe defaults, topic.Count(ctx, st, kind) as the sole topic_metrics writer, and the cmd/server/assemble.go skeleton wiring topic.Deps plus four placeholder Runners (topic-ingestor/topic-scheduler/llm-failure-watchdog/topic-pending-watchdog).

Rename accessors to match the contracted store access surface (Feedback(), Unfixable(), IngestLatency(), Cards(), ConfigOps()) and provide a dedicated topic.EnsureIndexes(ctx, st) error wrapper instead of appending into the existing store.EnsureIndexes.
